_README: Label id -> structure name for the deltoid volume derived from the Visible Human male colour cryosections by scripts/cryo/deltoid_from_cryo.py, plus the mapping onto atlas entities.

A KEY, not data. Rule-based: muscle-coloured voxels within 55 mm of the proximal humerus, within 40 mm of the skin, lateral to the scapula's lateral edge, not already labelled as pectoralis major / latissimus / serratus / trapezius (hybrid-CT run) or biceps / triceps (arm compartments); one connected piece per slice. The deltoid is the only muscle between the skin and the proximal humerus laterally, which is what the rule encodes; its deep boundary against the rotator cuff and its posterior extent over the scapular spine are approximate.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), male colour cryosections, IDC series 4aaf9181-fb6a-4a4c-bf49-d1eb9ed4a385, registered to the CT (scripts/cryo/README.md). Rule from standard anatomy: Standring S (ed.), Gray's Anatomy, 42nd ed., 'Shoulder girdle and arm'.

deltoid_right.note: Rule-based extraction; deep and posterior boundaries approximate.
